description: Fires when the opponent has three stones stacked on top of column 0 (leftmost) with the cell above empty: a vertical must-block in column 0. Strongest right after the third stone is played, and when the three sits on my stones. My own vertical three in column 0 fires weakly. Vertical threes in other columns and horizontal or diagonal threats at column 0 do not. About two thirds of firing is a weak, diffuse tail with no clear pattern.
effect: Supports blocking in column 0: zeroing it on a firing board dropped P(col 0) from 1.00 to 0.59 (mass moved to col 3); usually the block is already certain so steering changes little. Forcing it high on non-firing boards has only small diffuse effects.
notes: Core rule (their col-0 vertical three) has precision 0.99 and covers all activations above ~2.4 (top 1%), confirmed by minimal pairs (same pattern in cols 1-6 ~0; block it -> ~0; horizontal threat at col 0 ~0). But the 97th-percentile threshold (0.585 vs max 33) lets in a weak tail of 0.6-2.4 that is 2/3 of firing and I found no pattern for it; adding other-column vertical threes (F1 0.30) or col 6 (0.45) hurt. Best dev F1 0.493 (P 0.974, R 0.330), sim share 0.77.
